en: The image depicts a historic public square with a large ornate baroque fountain as the central feature. The fountain consists of multiple tiers and is adorned with elaborate sculptures, including human figures and mythological creatures. In the background, traditional European buildings with shuttered windows and red-tiled roofs are visible. The foreground is shaded by trees, framing the fountain in the center.
